name: Capital Auto Center
niche: auto repair shop / mechanic (European specialty, all makes and models)
address_source: Confirmed independently across Giftly, AutoTechIQ, Yahoo Local (Yelp mirror), BenzShops, BimmerShops, MiniRepairShops and EuroRepairHQ, all listing the identical address and matching the phone number given for this job.
email_search_notes: Searched Google Business Profile mirrors, Yelp, Facebook page (login-walled, could not confirm About info), BBB search (no listing found), Chamber of Commerce directory (blocked), Sunbiz Florida corporate entity search (blocked, entity found: CAPITAL AUTO CENTER LLC), Dun & Bradstreet company profile (blocked). No public email surfaced anywhere.
own_site_check_result: capitalautocenter.com resolves (HTTP 200) but redirects to forsale.godaddy.com: it is a parked domain-for-sale page, not a real business website. The other variant domains have no DNS record. No official website found in web search for the exact business name. Confirmed: no own website.
rating_source: Verified directly on Google Maps by the requester (no Website button on the listing). Independently corroborated by AutoTechIQ (4.7, address and hours match) and by Nears.me (4.7-star rating from 170 Google reviews, explicitly labeled 'Google Rating', an earlier snapshot with a lower review count than the 224 given for this job).
yelp_rating: 3.0 stars from 16 reviews (separate platform, not used as the headline stat; shown for transparency since some testimonial quotes below are sourced from Yelp).

hours.source: Consistent across AutoTechIQ, Yahoo Local (Yelp mirror), BenzShops, BimmerShops, MiniRepairShops and EuroRepairHQ listings.

established: 2019 (per Giftly business description: 'serving the community since its grand opening in April 2019').
facebook: https://www.facebook.com/CapitalAutoCenter/ (page exists per search results; content could not be read, Facebook served a login wall to the fetch tool)
note_on_google_review_quotes: Google's own review widget is JavaScript-rendered and could not be scraped with the tools available in this session (search engines and Google Maps returned JS-only shells; Yelp, Facebook, CARFAX, Wheree, Chamber of Commerce and BestProsInTown all returned HTTP 403). The verbatim quotes below were recovered from a Yahoo Local mirror that embeds real, attributed Yelp reviews for this same business (same address and phone) as plain JSON in server-rendered HTML. They are labeled '· Yelp' on the site, not '· Google', to stay accurate about their source, while the headline 4.7/224 stat displayed on the site is the Google Maps figure given for this job.

owner_or_lead_tech_note: No single named 'owner' was confirmed in any public record (the Florida entity is CAPITAL AUTO CENTER LLC). 'Ivan' is named directly, by multiple independent real reviewers across different dates, as the person customers deal with at the shop (described as trustworthy and helpful). The site and outreach draft refer to him by name on that basis.
certifications: ASE Recertified Master Technician and ASE Certified Advanced Level Specialist, confirmed from a real photo of both physical ASE badges found among the business's public photos.
specialty: European and German vehicles (BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Volkswagen, Volvo, MINI, Porsche, Jaguar, Land Rover) per EuroRepairHQ, BenzShops, BimmerShops and MiniRepairShops shop profiles, while also servicing all makes and models per the shop's own storefront signage ('Expert Repair And Friendly Service, All Makes And Models Are Welcome!') and its front window brand logos (Jeep, Hyundai, Fiat, Ford, Infiniti, Jaguar, Mercedes-Benz, Rolls-Royce, BMW, Chevrolet, Dodge, GMC, Acura, Audi, Cadillac).
services_source: Giftly business description (complete automotive service and repair center, oil changes, brake repair, major engine overhauls), Nears.me shop profile (engine diagnostics, brake service, oil changes, suspension/steering, electrical diagnostics, check engine light diagnosis, scheduled maintenance, pre-purchase inspections), and the storefront signage/photos themselves. No official price list was found anywhere, so the site uses the adapted variant: real service categories with 'free estimate / call for a quote' instead of invented prices.

evidence: Address 2508 W Tennessee St, Tallahassee, FL 32304 confirmed across 6+ independent third-party listings, all matching the given phone number (850) 999-6426.

Florida Sunbiz corporate entity 'CAPITAL AUTO CENTER LLC' found in search results (direct Sunbiz page fetch was blocked, but the entity name and filing reference, L19000063690, surfaced through a Brave Search result snippet).

template_base: templates/dark/index.html (dark industrial base), re-themed from the Mizu champagne-gold palette to a burnt amber/copper automotive palette (--accent-deep #d1703f), with the bilingual data-es/data-en system and the isolated-key language toggle (siteforge:lang:<slug>) added on top, following the pattern already proven in output/h--and--h-auto-repair and output/outside-in-handyman-portcharlotte.
build_variant: Hybrid: a real, confirmed street address allowed a real Google Maps embed (unlike a typical adapted-variant build). Pricing follows the adapted-variant rule because no official price list exists: 'free estimate / call for a quote' instead of invented prices. Reviews are 2 real verbatim quotes (fewer than the usual 3-5) because Google's own review widget could not be scraped and only 2 of the recoverable Yelp quotes were both complete and clearly positive; documented above together with the 3 reviews found but not used.
web_search_budget_note: The WebSearch tool's budget was exhausted early in this session (shared across concurrently running sessions), after yielding the address, phone, rating and 'capitalautocenter.com is a parked domain' facts. All subsequent research (reviews, photos, Facebook/Yelp/BBB checks, aggregator profiles) was done via WebFetch and direct curl requests to specific URLs, not via further web search.
notes: Phone, address and rating all cross-confirmed across 7+ independent third-party sources. Owner identity is inferred from repeated, consistent review mentions of 'Ivan' rather than from a corporate filing (the LLC filing does not name individual members in the public search snippet available). Email is genuinely not public; outreach channel is phone/SMS only.
